corrections.old_text: ስድስተኛው ሰንጠረዠ ሁለቱ ወንጌላውያን ማቴዎስና ማርቆስ የሚተባበሩበት ።
corrections.corrected_text: ስድስተኛው ሰንጠረዥ ሁለቱ ወንጌላውያን ማቴዎስና ማርቆስ የሚተባበሩበት ።
corrections.reason: The 6th-order ዥ in ሰንጠረዥ was misread as 1st-order ዠ.
The initial character is 6th-order እ (እስመሁ, 'is it because...'), visually confirmed by the zig-zag middle stroke of እ.
The printed Ge'ez gerundive is clearly ወተሣሊቆሙ ('and having mocked him, they stripped him', Matt 27:31 / Mark 15:20), misread as ወተሣለቅዎ.
